answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, burned when the recruit misbehaves. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The nebula of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the timber of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the shale re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
